product_metadata.title: Mesh Screen Food Cover Tents, 4 Pack Umbrella Screens to Keep Bugs and Flies Away From Food at Picnics, BBQ & More
features: Set of 4 Large Mesh Pop Up Food Covers, 4 Colors - Green, Blue, Pink, Yellow. provide more options for different taste.
Umbrella Desgin with Lace On The Bottom, Very Easy To Use. Just pull the opening wire to open and press the holding bottom to fold. Even kids can do it easily.

Very Portable and Smart Reusable Carry Bag To Pack - Take this little package out to any place conveniently. After use, you can wash it by water wipe and let it dry. Then store This little stuff at any place in your house, kitchen, save much space for you.
Keeps Out Flies, Bugs, and Mosquitos Perfectly for BBQ, Picnics, Pool Parties, Birthday Parties and Camping Trips, etc.
Each Food Cover Measures around 16"x16" (Square) and 11" Tall - Covers 16" Plates, these 4 Tents are enough for big parties.
description: The Perfect Choice for Your Delicious Food - 4 Pack Colorful Food Cover

Are you hate of flies,mosquitoes and bugs around your delicious dishes? Are you tired of the ants crawling along the picnic table and spoiling your barbeque? Are you depressed when watching flies and other insects crawl on a meal you spent all day preparing for your guests?  Now It Is Time to Choose Popup Food Covers! Why it Can Keep Your Dish More Fresh?  ★【Description 】  Keep flies, mosquitoes, bees and other bugs away from your food with this Umbrella-style food tent. Bring this beautiful elegant lace umbrella with you to family BBQs, picnics and other outdoor events, and use them to cover buffet trays, desert platters or individual plates. The mesh material ensures a smooth air circulation and gives you a clear view of the items inside the umbrella.  ★【Features:】

❤️Made with top-quality materials, including premium organza net and zinc-plated steel wire, these mesh food protectors are durable enough to guard your spectacular spreads for years to come. ❤️More Tight Mesh,it is better to keep your delicacies safe from all mosquitos, flies, ants, and even other small pests.  ❤️Easy Open and Close – Collapsible, umbrella-like design allows for quick setup and space saving storage when not in use. Lightweight materials for long-lasting use ❤️Bright Color with decant lace side,it is definitely wonderful decoration to your kitchen and picnic feast. ❤️The tent’s large size 16 inch x 16 inch can cover a wide array of plate sizes and beverages.
